<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/reactivate"}
#docs
Any field below restarts it with those options. The fresh term is invoiced and collected unless `trial_end` or `charges_handling: add_to_unbilled_charges` defers it; with auto-collection on, a failed charge refuses the reactivation when the business requires a successful charge (402), and anything this call applied is taken back off.

In-term reactivation: a subscription that dunning cancelled (`cancel_reason` `no_card` or `not_paid`) and whose term has not ended continues that term when the request keeps its items, sets no `trial_end`, `reactivate_from` or payment fields, and does not send `term: new`. No invoice is raised and the term's invoice keeps its balance. When the business requires a successful charge and auto-collection is on, that invoice is collected once first, and a failure refuses the reactivation (402).

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `array of object` | no | The full desired line set; omitted keeps the subscription's items. |
| `items.price` | `string` | **yes** | The price's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro-monthly-usd`). |
| `items.quantity` | `integer` | no | The quantity. |
| `items.unit_price_minor` | `integer` | no | A unit price in minor units, in place of the price's own. |
| `items.free_quantity` | `integer` | no | Units of this item free in each billing period. Overrides the price's `free_quantity`. |
| `items.billing_cycles` | `integer` | no | Number of billing cycles this item is charged for. |
| `billing_cycles` | `integer` | no | Number of billing cycles the reactivated subscription runs for. |
| `trial_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | When the new trial ends (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `charges_handling` | `string` | no | How charges for the reactivation are billed: invoiced now or kept as unbilled charges. One of `invoice_immediately`, `add_to_unbilled_charges`. |
| `term` | `string` | no | Omitted: continue the current term when the subscription is eligible (see In-term reactivation), else start a new term. `continue` refuses with 400 when it is not eligible. `new` always starts a new term and bills it. One of `continue`, `new`. |
| `reactivate_from` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | Backdate the fresh term's start (the invoice is dated from it). Only for a cancelled subscription; must be in the past, not before the cancellation, not after `trial_end`, and inside the business's backdating window for `reactivate` (400 otherwise). |
| `payment_intent` | `string` | no | An intent (`pi_…`, purpose `payment`) the buyer has authorized for the fresh term's amount due. The invoice is raised and settled by consuming it instead of a bare charge — how a reactivation that needed 3DS finishes. Must belong to this customer, be `authorized`, and match the amount and currency (400 otherwise). A refused capture voids and re-cancels when the business requires a successful charge (402); otherwise the invoice stays open in dunning and the response carries `payment_error`. |
| `payment_initiator` | `string` | no | `customer`: the buyer is present, so an authentication challenge on the charge comes back as 402 `requires_action` with `payment_intent` + `next_action` (nothing is written); complete it and retry with `payment_intent`. Needs the charge to be taken before reactivating (the business requires a successful charge on reactivation), else 400. `merchant` (default): off-session, as before. One of `customer`, `merchant`. |
| `coupon_code` | `string` | no | A coupon to apply to the reactivated subscription before its first invoice. |
| `coupon_ids` | `array of string` | no | `coupon_code` as a list; at most one entry. |
| `manual_discount` | `object` | no | A manual discount to apply before the first invoice. Refused when another discount is active. |
| `manual_discount.type` | `string` | **yes** | The discount type. One of `percent`, `amount`. |
| `manual_discount.value` | `number` | **yes** | Percent 1-100, or a positive amount in minor units |
| `manual_discount.duration` | `string` | no | How long the discount lasts. One of `one_time`, `forever`. Defaults to `"forever"`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The subscription's id (sub_…). |
| `status` | `string` | The subscription's status. One of `future`, `in_trial`, `active`, `non_renewing`, `paused`, `cancelled`. |
| `currency` | `string` | The subscription's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `current_period_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | The current billing term end. NULL while `in_trial` — a trial is not a term, so a trialling subscription reports `trial_end` instead and this is null (one or the other is reported, never both). Use `next_billing_at` for "when is this customer charged again?", which answers across every status. |
| `next_billing_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the next invoice will be raised: trial end while in_trial, the scheduled start while future, the first renewal not skipped while active (or the next monthly usage invoice, when it is earlier); null once non_renewing/paused/cancelled, where no further invoice is due |
| `bill_usage_monthly` | `boolean` | Metered usage is invoiced every month inside the billing period. |
| `current_sub_period_start` | `string · ISO-8601` | Monthly usage billing: usage before this instant is billed. Null when monthly usage billing is off. |
| `current_sub_period_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | Monthly usage billing: when the next monthly usage invoice is raised. Null when off. |
| `commitment` | `object` | Minimum commitment for one full billing period, or null. See GET /subscriptions/{id}/commitment for the counted fees. |
| `skipped_renewals` | `array of string · ISO-8601` | Upcoming renewals scheduled to be skipped, as the instants the clock renews at. See `skip_renewal`. |
| `recurring_amount_minor` | `integer` | What one billing period charges for the recurring items, in minor units, net of discounts that last more than one period and before tax; null when cancelled or when an item recurs on a different cadence than the subscription |
| `revenue_to_date_minor` | `integer` | DERIVED, read-only: cash collected on this subscription's invoices, in its currency — succeeded payments minus succeeded refunds. Credits applied to invoices are excluded. Emitted by GET (detail) only. |
| `revenue_paid_invoices_count` | `integer` | How many of this subscription's invoices received a succeeded payment. |
| `revenue_since` | `string · ISO-8601` | The first succeeded payment on this subscription; null when nothing was collected. |
| `custom_fields` | `object` | Stored custom-field values; also flattened onto the object as cf_&lt;name&gt; |
| `shipping_address_id` | `string` | The shipping address this subscription is set to ship to; null when it ships to the customer's default. Emitted by GET (detail), create, and an update that sends it. |
| `shipping_address` | `object` | Where this subscription ships now: its own address, else the customer's default, else null. Invoices record a copy when they are issued. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Not cancelable, or an invalid item set / coupon / discount |
| `402` | The fresh term's charge failed (the subscription stays cancelled), or `requires_action`: the buyer must authenticate |
| `404` | No such subscription |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/reactivate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "billing_cycles": 1,
    "trial_end": "2026-04-14T09:30:00Z"
  }'
```
